title: Wheat acreage estimation in central Punjab using Sentinel-2 time series
abstract: Random forest classification of Sentinel-2 NDVI time series over the Rabi season for Faisalabad and Jhang districts, validated against provincial crop reporting data. Overall accuracy of 89 percent.

title: Flood extent mapping of the 2020 monsoon in Sindh with Sentinel-1 SAR
abstract: Change detection on Sentinel-1 VV backscatter to delineate inundated area across five districts, with damage assessment against WorldPop population and OSM infrastructure.

title: Web-based dashboard for union council vaccination coverage in Rawalpindi
abstract: A Leaflet and PostGIS application for an NGO partner to visualise coverage, flag low-performing areas, and export reports. Deployed on a free cloud tier.

title: UAV photogrammetric survey and volumetric analysis of a housing scheme earthworks
abstract: Orthomosaic and DSM generation from 1,200 images with ground control, accuracy assessment against total station checkpoints, and cut-and-fill volumes for the contractor.

title: Three decades of urban expansion in Rawalpindi-Islamabad from Landsat
abstract: Built-up area classification for 1990, 2000, 2010 and 2020, landscape metrics, and a comparison with master plan zoning to identify unplanned growth corridors.
